whenToUse: Pages people keep on paper or as a PDF: a CV, an invoice, a recipe, a ticket, a programme.
Any page that should print without the navigation, footer and banners (PrintStyles).
avoidWhen: Generating a real PDF file on the server (invoices with a legal layout) — render the PDF in the app and link to it.
a11y: A real button with a description of what happens ("Opens the print dialog…"); the button itself never prints.
The print stylesheet prints link addresses, so the paper copy keeps where links pointed.
